bot_token.description: Developer Portal -> your app -> Bot -> Reset Token. Use a { secret = ... } or { env = ... } reference.

channel_id.description: Channel to post in (Developer Mode on, right-click the channel -> Copy Channel ID).

allowed_responders.description: Discord user ids whose answers count as the owner's. Everyone else is ignored.

mention.description: @-mention the allowed responders on questions and approvals so their phone rings.

poll_interval.description: How often the server polls for answers. One or two API calls per open request.

notify_on.description: Case events that also post an informational message.
